items.title: Store and process large strings in Amazon Redshift SUPER columns
items.summary: Storing large semi-structured data such as JSON and arrays in a data warehouse often means splitting or truncating your data. With PartiQL and the SUPER data type, Amazon Redshift is now equipped to handle these issues. In this post, we walk you through three key SUPER data type enhancements that simplify semi-structured data workflows and reduce common migration challenges.
items.creator: Ritesh Sinha
